method.rawDataPreservation: All four original audit objects, including every scenario raw array and native pan record, are retained without filtering in the digest-bound raw JSON blob.
checks: Exactly two early and two full profiles, matched by original profile names, with all original eight scenarios each.
Original assertSmoothnessAudit release mode on each full original audit, using the unmodified strict numeric thresholds.

Validated native pan input witness, original source/environment comparator and native surface coverage.
Verified CPU rate 1, successful restoration, no tracing, no raw recorder error/overflow/hidden/pending-input contamination.

method.percentile: Original nearest-rank p95; raw values are not rounded before comparison.
method.thresholdComparison: Strict less-than. A value of exactly 35 ms remains a failure of the original frameP95Ms gate.

limitations: These numbers qualify the measured 79b5 source and environment, not the later final 0770 source. The latter must pass its own unchanged original Pages gates.
The 79b5 runner uses AMD EPYC 9V45; the earlier failed f0c4 runner used EPYC 7763 and accepted 8020 used EPYC 9V74. This is not a controlled same-machine performance A/B comparison.
79b5 is an independently required archive-packaging fix with no renderer change. No quantitative rendering improvement or cause of f0c4's failure is attributed to it.
This compact recovery validates accepted artifact identity and original JSON evidence. Fresh independent decoding of the separate design PNG bytes is not part of this review.
No new trace, browser run, acceptance measurement, repeated performance gate, main/ref mutation or publication was performed by this review.
The full desktop zoom window contains one 52 ms long task and a 53.7 ms maximum frame gap; both are within the unchanged original thresholds. No zero-long-task claim is made.
